The Subtask Name: PRD Creation

- From_agent: Product Manager
  To_agent: Product Manager

  agent_strength: 0.95

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: The Product Manager may repeatedly insert content at the same line number without advancing the document state, causing redundant or conflicting edits.
      severity: 0.8

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Architect may receive an unclear or inconsistent PRD, affecting the accuracy of the software architecture design.
